title: Agentrys raises $24.5 million to put AI agents across the chip-design pipeline
summary: U.S. chip-design startup Agentrys disclosed a $24.5 million combined seed and pre-seed round led by Etna Labs with MediaTek as the first strategic backer. The company says its agents have already produced a sign-off-clean 32-bit CPU layout from a written specification without human intervention.
